author: /root/hhs_current_candidate

independence.disclosure: Author previously inspected the pinned existing product and Chromium checker during a read-only repository audit. This freeze is independent of the new Guidepup harness; it is not a product-blind holdout.

inputs.versionsPolicy: Record actual macOS build, runner image, architecture, Safari and VoiceOver versions, locale, installed package versions and source/lock hashes. Missing or incompatible prerequisites are disclosed, not silently substituted.

interactionPolicy.browser: Actual native Safari with actual running VoiceOver; not Playwright WebKit, an accessibility-tree mock, or synthesized narration.
interactionPolicy.allowed: Native keyboard/VoiceOver commands; read-only DOM snapshots for readiness, activeElement, geometry and values; documented OS/browser/VoiceOver setup before cases, identical and recorded for both refs.
interactionPolicy.initialSkipReach: Choose and record ordinary Tab or documented Option+Tab before the baseline. Record Safari keyboard/tab preference and Quick Nav state. Use the same choice on candidate; no hidden fallback after a failed assertion.
interactionPolicy.navigationBound: At most 40 native navigation keypresses to reach a target; preserve the actual sequence and intermediate focus observations.
interactionPolicy.nextTab: An ordinary Tab immediately after the settled heading observation; VO-F4 reporting may precede it but must not move focus.
interactionPolicy.prohibited: No DOM focus(), click(), dispatchEvent(), selected-value assignment, direct render call, injected repair, forced accessibility name, or programmatic navigation to the target control. No expected text inserted into captured speech.
interactionPolicy.readiness: Use document/Swagger rendering and actual version/value readiness, not the repaired Server accessible name, as a prerequisite.
interactionPolicy.speech: At each speech checkpoint record a fresh VO-F4 current-keyboard-focus report after the relevant action/wait. Retain raw session speech and mark new-event offsets/timestamps; never satisfy a later checkpoint from an earlier utterance.
interactionPolicy.matching: Meaningful name/role/value may ignore case, whitespace and spoken punctuation. Server or Servers is a meaningful purpose name. Literal version paths or unambiguous spoken equivalents are acceptable when separately evidenced; do not infer spoken words from DOM text. Ambiguous speech remains UNVERIFIED.

cases.name: Reach Skip by native keyboard
cases.pass: Actual native keyboard focus reaches the visible Skip to content link on the loaded API-docs page; key sequence and read-only activeElement evidence are preserved.

cases.name: Activate Skip
cases.pass: Enter from the focused link transfers actual keyboard focus to h1#_top inside main. A fresh VO-F4 report meaningfully identifies OpenAPI docs as the heading; preserve actual speech and DOM evidence.

cases.name: Settled heading
cases.pass: After at least 15000 ms of measured settling with no focus-moving or repairing action, h1#_top remains the active element, visible below the fixed header and within the viewport. A fresh VO-F4 report after the wait still identifies the heading.
cases.geometry: target top >= header bottom - 1 CSS px; target bottom <= viewport height; target height > 0; record measured values and elapsed time.

cases.name: Next ordinary Tab
cases.pass: The next ordinary Tab reaches #version-select inside main. A fresh VO-F4 report identifies API Version and its current selection; preserve actual focus and speech.

cases.name: Server at 0.5.0
cases.pass: Native keyboard navigation reaches the top-level Swagger Server selector. Its actual value is /api/v0.5.0, and a fresh VO-F4 report identifies the Server purpose and that value.

cases.name: Keyboard version change
cases.pass: Reach API Version using native keyboard input and select 0.4.0 using the native control. Read-only evidence establishes selected API Version 0.4.0, URL version=0.4.0, rendered Swagger version 0.4.0 and Server value /api/v0.4.0 after redraw.

cases.name: Server after redraw
cases.pass: Native keyboard navigation reaches the newly rendered top-level Server selector. A fresh VO-F4 report still identifies the Server purpose and /api/v0.4.0; preserve actual focus, value and speech.

evidenceGates.name: Actual visible recording
evidenceGates.pass: Retain real screen recording of native Safari and the exercised sequence, with relevant reader state visible. Verify video metadata, duration and actual frames at the checkpoints. A speech text file, DOM snapshot, still-image sequence or fabricated demonstration is not this recording. Separate native clips are allowed only with their session/build identities explicitly preserved.

evidenceGates.name: Actual system audio and separate verification
evidenceGates.pass: Capture actual VoiceOver system audio in the recorded session and retain original media. Verify an audio stream and signal, then separately verify relevant recorded utterances with an identified capable reviewer/tool and timestamps. A non-silent stream or spokenPhraseLog alone does not prove the recorded words. Without that verification, audio content remains UNVERIFIED and full recording acceptance remains INCOMPLETE.

evidenceRecord: Acceptance-file hash and frozen harness hash, source repository/ref/commit, clean/dirty state, lockfile hash and build command.
Per-file inventory and SHA-256 of actual served build before/after the run; preserve output identity rather than assuming an old build matches.
Actual runner/macOS/Safari/VoiceOver/Node/pnpm/Guidepup/setup versions, locale, keyboard preferences and native window readiness.
Timestamped native key sequence, read-only snapshots, measured 15-second interval, fresh speech-event boundaries and complete raw speech log.
All case results and failures, setup logs, media originals/hashes, visual checkpoints, audio-verification method/result and shutdown status.

resultPolicy.sameAttack: Run the same frozen assertions and navigation policy on baseline and candidate. Baseline failure is a hypothesis until actually reproduced; never manufacture FIRST RED.
resultPolicy.functionalPass: All seven cases must pass. Failure or a dependent case not reached prevents a seven-case PASS.
resultPolicy.completeEvidence: Full native recording acceptance requires functional PASS plus both recording gates. Speech-log verification is reported separately from audio listening.
resultPolicy.failureClassification: Record stage and observed evidence. Unsupported GUI/VoiceOver, permissions, install/build failure, unavailable audio or harness failure do not establish a product FIRST RED. Do not classify every timeout as infrastructure or every timeout as a product defect without evidence.
resultPolicy.preserve: Preserve every run and failure in a fresh output location. Safe later diagnostic steps may continue but cannot erase earlier failures. Any fixture/harness/criteria correction after execution is separately versioned and explained; V1 remains immutable.
resultPolicy.baselineNotReproduced: If baseline cannot execute or does not reproduce a product failure, report that limitation even if candidate observations pass.

scopeLimits: API-docs route only; not fresh proof for all 181 routes or full WCAG conformance.
Fresh macOS/Safari/VoiceOver evidence only; existing Windows/NVDA evidence retains its historical source/build/environment scope.
No automatic PR Ready transition, reviewer request, message, merge or deployment is authorized by this freeze.
